value.value:
@concat('"SELECT  R.[ReceiptId]
      ,R.[BatchId]
      ,R.[ReceiptReason]
      ,R.[GroupId]
   ,cast(ltrim(rtrim(R.[SubscriberId])) as varchar(9)) as [SubscriberId]
      ,cast(ltrim(rtrim(R.[BillingGroupId])) as varchar(8)) as [BillingGroupId] 
      ,R.[Amount]
      ,ISNULL(R.[CheckNum],'''') [CheckNum]
      ,R.[ReceivedDate]
      ,R.[Source]
 
  FROM [Receipts].[Receipt] R
  JOIN [Receipts].Batch B
  ON B.BatchId=R.BatchId
  AND B.BatchStatusId IN (SELECT BatchStatusId FROM [Receipts].[BatchStatus] 
WHERE UPPER(BatchStatus) IN (''TRANSMITTED'',''POSTING''))
 where R.[FACReceiptId]  is null and B.BatchDate > getdate()-"', string(variables('gv_LookBackDays')), '  order by R.ReceivedDate desc')
@concat('select RECEIPTID, FACRECEIPTID, GROUPID, SUBSCRIBERID, RECEIVEDDATE, AMOUNT,CHECKNUM,FACRECEIPTDATE,BATCHID  from ', variables('gv_LookupTable'), ' where facreceiptid is not null')

SELECT [RECEIPTID] ,R.[BATCHID] ,[FACRECEIPTID] ,[PAYMENTTYPEID] ,[PAYMENTTYPE] ,[RECEIPTREASONID] ,[RECEIPTREASON] ,[PAYMETHODID] ,[PAYMETHOD] ,[VENDORREFID] ,[GROUPID] ,[SUBGROUPID] ,CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM([SUBSCRIBERID])) AS VARCHAR(9)) AS [SUBSCRIBERID] ,CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM([BILLINGGROUPID])) AS VARCHAR(8)) AS [BILLINGGROUPID] ,[AFAID] ,[AMOUNT] ,ISNULL([CHECKNUM],'') [CHECKNUM] ,[RECEIVEDDATE] ,[HOLDINGACCT] ,[INVOICEID] ,[RETURNREASON] ,[FREQUENCY] ,[TRANTYPE] ,[FACRECEIPTDATE] ,R.[SOURCE] ,[GROUPIND] ,[EXCLUDEIND] ,CAST(BatchId as DOUBLE) AS {Copy of BatchId},CAST(ReceivedDate as VARCHAR) AS {Copy of ReceivedDate},CAST(Amount as INTEGER) AS {Copy of Amount},CAST(ReceiptId as DOUBLE) AS {Copy of ReceiptId} FROM [RECEIPTS].[RECEIPT] R JOIN [RECEIPTS].BATCH B ON B.BATCHID=R.BATCHID AND B.BATCHSTATUSID IN (SELECT BATCHSTATUSID FROM [RECEIPTS].[BATCHSTATUS] WHERE UPPER(BATCHSTATUS) IN ('TRANSMITTED','POSTING')) WHERE [FACRECEIPTID] IS NULL AND R.BATCHID = '1528' ORDER BY R.RECEIVEDDATE DESC
SELECT * ,CAST(AMOUNT as DECIMAL) AS {Copy of Amount},CAST(RECEIPTID as INTEGER) AS {Copy of ReceiptId} FROM AGP.RECEIPT_KEYWORD_LOOKUP WHERE FACRECEIPTID IS NOT NULL

scripts.text:
update rcpt 
set rcpt.FACReceiptId =post.FACReceiptId,
rcpt.FACReceiptDate=post.FACReceiptDate
 from  Receipts.Receipt rcpt
 join Receipts.PostBackLookupReceipt post
 on rcpt.ReceiptId = post.ReceiptId
 and post.FACReceiptId not in (select distinct FACReceiptId from Receipts.Receipt where FACReceiptId is not null)
;

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT RCPT.BATCHID ,RCPT.[FACRECEIPTID],RCPT.[RECEIPTID],GETDATE() AS CREATEDATE,GETDATE() AS UPDATEDATE,RCPT.VENDORREFID, (CASE WHEN RCPT.FREQUENCY=1 THEN 'ONE TIME' WHEN RCPT.FREQUENCY=2 THEN 'RECURRING' END) AS FREQUENCY1,RCPT.FILLER,RCPT.KY_HCID  FROM RECEIPTS.RECEIPT RCPT JOIN RECEIPTS.POSTBACKLOOKUPRECEIPT LKP ON LKP.RECEIPTID= RCPT.RECEIPTID WHERE RCPT.[FACRECEIPTID] IS NOT NULL;

SELECT RCPT.BATCHID ,RCPT.[FACRECEIPTID],RCPT.[RECEIPTID],GETDATE() AS CREATEDATE,GETDATE() AS UPDATEDATE,RCPT.VENDORREFID, (CASE WHEN RCPT.FREQUENCY=1 THEN 'ONE TIME' WHEN RCPT.FREQUENCY=2 THEN 'RECURRING' END) AS FREQUENCY1,RCPT.FILLER,RCPT.KY_HCID  FROM RECEIPTS.RECEIPT RCPT JOIN RECEIPTS.POSTBACKLOOKUPRECEIPT LKP ON LKP.RECEIPTID= RCPT.RECEIPTID WHERE RCPT.[FACRECEIPTID] IS NOT NULL AND ( RCPT.BILLINGGROUPID LIKE 'GRS%' OR RCPT.BILLINGGROUPID LIKE 'GRX%' )

select DT.* FROM AGP.BOSS_RECEIPT_DATA DT WHERE RCPT_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT RCPT_ID FROM  CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT WHERE RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_BGBG_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT BGBG_ID FROM AGP.BILLING_EGR_BGBG_XWALK ))

gv_DUL.defaultValue:
'INSERT INTO AGP.RECEIPT_KEYWORD_TEMP(rownumbersql,BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,subscriberid,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSCRIBERID, GROUPID, RECEIVEDDATE,CHECKNUM, AMOUNT,RECEIPT_REASON ORDER BY receiveddate desc) AS rownumbersql,
        BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,SUBSCRIBERID,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src    
    FROM AGP.RECEIPT_KEYWORD_LOOKUP
    WHERE SUBSCRIBERID IS NOT NULL
    AND (SUBSCRIBERID,GROUPID, RECEIVEDDATE,nvl(CHECKNUM,0), AMOUNT,RECEIPT_REASON)  IN (
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBERID,GROUPID, RECEIVEDDATE,nvl(CHECKNUM,0), AMOUNT,RECEIPT_REASON FROM
(
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSCRIBERID, GROUPID, RECEIVEDDATE,CHECKNUM, AMOUNT,RECEIPT_REASON order by receiveddate) as rownumbersql,
       BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,SUBSCRIBERID,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src    
  FROM AGP.RECEIPT_KEYWORD_LOOKUP
  WHERE SUBSCRIBERID <> ' '
  AND FACRECEIPTID IS NULL
  GROUP BY BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,SUBSCRIBERID,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src    
)T WHERE T.rownumbersql > 1
)
GROUP BY BATCHID,
    FACRECEIPTID,
    FACRECEIPTDATE,
    groupid,
    subscriberid,
    receiveddate,
    billinggroupid,
    amount,
    RECEIPT_REASON,
    checknum,
    receiptid,
    src 
    
    
    
UNION


SELECT ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY billinggroupid , receiveddate,checknum,amount,RECEIPT_REASON ORDER BY receiveddate) AS rownumbersql,
        BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,subscriberid,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src    
    FROM AGP.RECEIPT_KEYWORD_LOOKUP
     WHERE BILLINGGROUPID IS NOT NULL
    AND (BILLINGGROUPID,receiveddate, nvl(CHECKNUM,0),amount,RECEIPT_REASON )  IN(
SELECT DISTINCT BILLINGGROUPID,receiveddate, nvl(CHECKNUM,0),amount,RECEIPT_REASON  FROM
(
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY billinggroupid , receiveddate,checknum,amount,RECEIPT_REASON order by receiveddate) as rownumbersql,
       BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,subscriberid,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src    
  FROM AGP.RECEIPT_KEYWORD_LOOKUP
  WHERE BILLINGGROUPID <> ' '
  AND FACRECEIPTID IS NULL
  GROUP BY BATCHID,FACRECEIPTID,FACRECEIPTDATE,receiptid,groupid,subscriberid,receiveddate,billinggroupid,amount,RECEIPT_REASON,checknum,src    
)T
WHERE T.rownumbersql > 1
)
GROUP BY BATCHID,
    FACRECEIPTID,
    FACRECEIPTDATE,
    groupid,
    subscriberid,
    receiveddate,
    billinggroupid,
    amount,
    RECEIPT_REASON,
    checknum,
    receiptid,
    src'

    RECEIPT_REASON,

str_SelectReceiptData.defaultValue:
'SELECT  R.[ReceiptId]
      ,R.[BatchId]
      ,R.[ReceiptReason]
      ,R.[GroupId]
   ,cast(ltrim(rtrim(R.[SubscriberId])) as varchar(9)) as [SubscriberId]
      ,cast(ltrim(rtrim(R.[BillingGroupId])) as varchar(8)) as [BillingGroupId] 
      ,R.[Amount]
      ,ISNULL(R.[CheckNum],'') [CheckNum]
      ,R.[ReceivedDate]
      ,R.[Source]
 
  FROM [Receipts].[Receipt] R
  JOIN [Receipts].Batch B
  ON B.BatchId=R.BatchId
  AND B.BatchStatusId IN (SELECT BatchStatusId FROM [Receipts].[BatchStatus] 
WHERE UPPER(BatchStatus) IN ('TRANSMITTED','POSTING'))
 where R.[FACReceiptId]  is null and B.BatchDate > getdate()-9  order by R.ReceivedDate desc'
